goal: Change effect.txt only, preserve all other current tree entries and current ancestry; refuse semantic-read conflicts, concurrent write-target edits, or a ref changed after validation.
decision: Guarded-current patch must satisfy the full state/parent oracle in 21/21 cases; fixed snapshot must expose unrelated-state loss; unguarded current patch must expose write-target clobber. All 63 evidence-integrity audits must pass. Expected negative controls do not count as audit corruption.
stop: Once per fresh case ID. No result-seeking rerun. Stop on an unexpected harness/integrity error and retain the incomplete block.
limits: Authored read/write scopes and local bare Git. No GUI, Doom, model, network, performance, natural failure rate or power-loss claim. Old ref-replacement PASS results remain untouched; the new one-file-edit preservation goal is explicitly stronger.
